title: Compose Snapshot state tracking IAE 'Only add dependencies during a tracking block' at Lt4;.dispatchDraw pc=148

source.upstream_law: androidx.compose.runtime.snapshots.SnapshotStateObserver: snapshot-state reads are recorded ONLY inside a tracking block (observeReads scope); a read outside it raises IllegalArgumentException('Only add dependencies during a tracking block'). The LayoutNode draw cascade opens/closes the tracking window per node via OwnerSnapshotObserver.observeLayoutModifierSnapshotReads.
source.app_side_null_contract: AndroidComposeView.dispatchDraw passes NULL as the LayoutNode draw-state param for the root draw (Lt4;.dispatchDraw pc=45-46: const/4 v5,0; invoke-virtual {v4,v2,v5} Lel0;.i). Lpz0;.L0 stores that param into the draw-context holder Lkc;.c (pc=34). Lyl;.z (the CanvasDrawScope draw) reads Lkc;.c and guards with if-eqz (pc=258) — on ART the null guard SKIPS the tracker read entirely. Null checks + null casts are legal ART semantics.

fix.name: F-NEW-252 explicit-null-beats-initializer law
fix.law: A heap ENTRY holding NULL_REF is an explicitly written null and reads null; initializer materialization fires only for ABSENT entries or dangling refs.
fix.generality: No package/class/method conditions. Every APK whose draw/compose path passes a null context through a param slot into a heap field benefits. The original R414 purpose (chess ContentFrameLayout.mDecorPadding: inflater-materialized object whose <init> never ran = ABSENT entries) is preserved — anchors 5/5 x3 byte-identical after the change.
fix.considered_and_dropped: A param-slot integrity law in get_register (UNSET param reads answer null) was prototyped and dropped: runtime evidence (PARAM-TRACE t=8 at entry) showed the param arrived correctly as NULL_REF, so the read-side R414 law is the true single divergence point; the extra law never fired (0 hits) and was removed per minimalism.
